findings.defect: The translation drops the trailing contrast conveyed by 는데, making the thought sound conclusive instead of hesitant in light of the man’s incongruous appearance.
findings.rationale: The following narration explains why Taekyung finds himself questioning the otherwise obvious conclusion that the man is a Hunter.

findings.current: A student preparing to enter a physical education college, he had awakened as an A-rank Hunter on his twentieth birthday. With his exceptional ability and good looks, he had earned the title of a winner at life.
findings.defect: “A winner at life” is an unnatural literal calque that does not read as contemporary English.
findings.rationale: 인생의 승리자 describes someone enviably successful or fortunate in every respect; “a man who had it all” preserves that sense naturally.
findings.replacement: While preparing for college entrance exams in physical education, he awakened as an A-rank Hunter on his twentieth birthday. With his exceptional ability and good looks, he earned a reputation as a man who had it all.
findings.source: 체대 입시생이던 그는 스무 살 생일에 A급 헌터로 각성, 뛰어난 실력과 외모로 인생의 승리자라는 타이틀을 거머쥐었다.

findings.current: The person I respected most was my parents. My favorite Hunter was Won Myunghoon.
findings.defect: The singular subject “person” is incompatible with the plural “parents,” creating a grammatical and quantity mismatch.
findings.rationale: 부모님 refers collectively to Taekyung’s parents, so the English subject must be plural.
findings.replacement: The people I respected most were my parents. My favorite Hunter was Won Myunghoon.
findings.source: 존경하는 사람은 부모님. 가장 좋아하는 헌터는 원명훈.

findings.current: I hummed a few lines as a demonstration, and Team Leader Choi pretended to recognize the song.
findings.defect: “Pretended” asserts that Team Leader Choi was faking recognition, whereas the context shows that the song genuinely sounded familiar to him.
findings.rationale: Here 아는 척을 했다 means that Choi indicated recognition, as confirmed by his immediate statement that he thinks he has heard the song.
findings.replacement: I hummed a few lines as a demonstration, and Team Leader Choi showed a flicker of recognition.
findings.source: 내가 시범 삼아 몇 소절을 흥얼거리자 최 팀장도 아는 척을 했다.

findings.current: The man watched me stammer like an idiot. No—the A-rank Hunter Won Myunghoon reached his hand through the half-open window and offered it for a handshake.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the specific Mute Samryong allusion with a generic insult and splits the sentence into an awkward self-correction whose “No” no longer revises its subject coherently.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly compares Taekyung’s incoherent stammering to 벙어리 삼룡이 and then comically corrects “the man” to the celebrity Hunter’s full identity.
findings.replacement:
Seeing me splutter like Mute Samryong,[^1] the man—no, the A-rank Hunter Won Myunghoon—reached through the half-open window and offered me his hand.

[^1]: Mute Samryong is the title character of a well-known Korean short story.
findings.source: 벙어리 삼룡이처럼 어버버 거리는 나를 본 남자, 아니 A급 헌터 원명훈이 반쯤 열린 창문 안으로 손을 내밀어 악수를 청했다.

findings.current: “He went to take care of something. More importantly, hyung, please speak comfortably with me.”
findings.defect: “Speak comfortably with me” is an unnatural calque and obscures that Taekyung is inviting Won Myunghoon to drop formal speech.
findings.rationale: 말씀 편하게 하세요 is a request to use a less formal speech level, reflecting the newly proposed hyung-dongsaeng relationship.
findings.replacement: “He went to take care of something. More importantly, hyung, you can speak casually with me.”

findings.defect: The draft turns one vulgar intensifier into two separate strong expletives, intensifying the employee’s profanity beyond the source.
findings.rationale: 개 intensifies 쩐다 vulgarly, but 와 remains an ordinary exclamation equivalent to “wow.”

findings.current: “Please write, ‘Hye-gyeong, have a beautiful love with Jinwoo.’”
findings.defect: “Have a beautiful love with” is an unnatural English collocation that makes the punchline sound translated rather than spontaneous.
findings.rationale: 예쁜 사랑 하세요 is a conventional wish for a happy romantic relationship; the replacement conveys that naturally while retaining the absurd autograph request.
findings.replacement: “Please write, ‘Hye-gyeong, wishing you and Jinwoo a beautiful life together.’”
findings.source: “혜경 씨, 진우 씨와 예쁜 사랑 하세요. 라고 써 주세요.”

findings.defect: The source is an abrupt action beat or sound effect, but quotation marks make “Grab” look like spoken dialogue, and the bare imperative is not natural English narration.
findings.rationale: 덥석 conveys Won Myunghoon suddenly and firmly taking Taekyung’s hand immediately before making his offer.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it drops several pragmatic and comedic cues, introduces one false implication about Team Leader Choi, intensifies profanity, and contains a few unnatural or malformed renderings.
